content:
Alex Kim: Quick update — HorizonPulse interview wrapped this morning. Transcript + raw clips in GDrive: https://drive.redwood/hinge/horizonpulse/transcript. Need quote approvals + signed release by EOD Thu to hit 3/31 launch. Also want to fold the benchmark narrative into the post and schedule a webinar for 4/7. Who can own what?

Tess Rivera: Love it. Can we get two short soundbites for the launch post? 1-liner for the hero and a 2-3 sentence quote for the case study.

Samir Patel: I ran the client's workload on Dedicated yesterday. Quick numbers: p50 token latency ~42ms, p95 ~78ms, throughput steady at 120 req/s on the medium pool. Is "sub-100ms" ok for public messaging or do we want to be more precise?

Leah Wong: For marketing copy, "consistent sub-100ms token latency" is cleaner and safer. Avoid exact p95 unless client approves. We should also decide if we include the test scenario (seq len / prompt style).

Matt Chen: Legal note — need client-signed release for quotes + clips. Uploaded draft here: https://legal.redwood/releases/horizonpulse-draft. No competitor mentions. "Sub-100ms" is fine but flagging we should run final wording by the client before publishing.

Olivia Park: Growth asks that if launch is 3/31 we prep a webinar for 4/7 targeted at outbound accounts showing the benchmark. Sales wants inbound routing: any lead from the launch -> SDR queue "HorizonPulse-Launch" + tag "benchmark-interest". @Katie O'Neil can you set the routing and landing page?

Katie O'Neil: Yup — I can assemble the launch kit and set routing. Proposed deadlines: design assets to me by 3/28 EOD, final approved quote + release by 3/29, landing page and routing live by 3/30. I'll create the landing draft and share for quick review.

Alex Kim: I'll own client coordination for quote sign-off. Small publish checklist (copying here):
- Get signed release (Legal) -> owner: Matt Chen
- Final quote (one-liner + 2-3 sentence) -> owner: Tess Rivera / Alex Kim
- Design: hero image + 2 clips -> owner: Design (via Katie)
- Publish copy + blog post -> owner: Marketing (Katie)
- Webinar landing page + routing rule -> owner: Olivia / Katie
- Sales playbook snippet + inbound tag -> owner: Sales Ops
- Benchmark appendix (internal) -> owner: Samir Patel

Samir Patel: Adding the internal benchmark appendix will help SDRs having rebuttals. I'll export the short runbook and attach the CSV and graphs to the landing page.

Matt Chen: Sent redlines to client at 1738765500; flagged two minor wording changes (no infra vendor names). Waiting on client signature.

calendar-bot: Meeting scheduled: HorizonPulse final review w/ legal + client — Thu 3/28 10:00am PT (link: https://meet.redwood/xyz).

Tess Rivera: I'll draft the two soundbites and ping Alex for client wording by EOD today.

Katie O'Neil: Routing rule: will create tag "launch:horizonpulse" -> maps to SDR queue "HorizonPulse-Launch". Confirm Sales Ops contact?

Olivia Park: Sales Ops is @Jared (cc'd separately). Jared — please confirm queue config when Katie posts the PR.

Alex Kim: Thanks all. I'll nudge the client on the release and the short quote. If we get signature by 3/29 morning, we hit the 3/31 launch and 4/7 webinar cadence.

Matt Chen: Noted — will update thread when client signs.

Leah Wong: Quick note for copy: avoid absolute numbers in the hero. Use the appendix for specifics for SDRs.

Alex Kim: Perfect. Marking tasks and will follow up. :tada:
